events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A café-inspired CHANEL fragrance experience celebrating COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU, with personalized fragrance discovery, the broader COCO MADEMOISELLE line, makeup exploration and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the in-person fragrance discovery experience are free. CHANEL products are available to purchase onsite; no take-home giveaway is established by the official source.
events.caveats: CHANEL says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. An appointment is therefore optional rather than an approval step or guaranteed-entry claim. Normal capacity limits can still apply.
events.practical_notes: September 11: noon–7 PM; September 12–13: 10 AM–7 PM; September 18: noon–7 PM; September 19–20: 10 AM–7 PM. The official CHANEL event page provides the current appointment path.
